snippet.title: Miniature Legends - Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Survive in Tiny Lands—solo or with friends! Battle endless waves of creatures in small arenas, collect and upgrade powerful abilities, unlock new legends, and grow insanely strong in this fast-paced, chaotic roguelike board-battler.

Wishlist Now on Steam! 🔥
